Network Name: Arc of Appalachia — Scioto County Preserves
Partner Agencies: Clean Ohio; Ohio Natural Resources Conservation Service
Identity Notes: Arc of Appalachia is a nonprofit land trust that owns and manages 4 nature preserves in Scioto County. Together these preserves protect 1,656+ acres of Appalachian hill country, river corridors, and rare species habitat in the Little Scioto Watershed and Scioto River corridor.
